ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording from the Wall of Sound era with crystal‑clear detail, though specific musical highlights are not mentioned
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about Scott Clugston’s restoration work, calling this the best‑sounding audio they've heard from the Wall of Sound tour and noting that hidden details in the analog tapes have been brilliantly brought out. No particular songs or performance issues are discussed, but the overall impression is overwhelmingly positive regarding both the show’s vibe and the recording quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but it gives a perfect 5‑star rating and praises the audio quality strongly; lack of concrete show details keeps confidence low.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Praised for bringing out hidden detail from analog tapes, crisp and clear sound with no reported flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer focuses on overall vibe of the Wall of Sound tour performance.
